en.headline: Independent committee submits Tai Po fire report to Chief Executive
en.dek: The judge-led panel delivered its two-volume findings on the Wang Fuk Court blaze that killed 168 people, with John Lee pledging swift reforms and accountability.
body: The independent committee investigating the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po submitted its final report to Chief Executive John Lee on Thursday morning. The judge-led panel said it had completed its work after holding 30 hearings between March and July.

Sources familiar with the document said the report runs to more than ten chapters and between 800 and 900 pages, or about 330,000 words, in both Chinese and English. It is understood to single out four government bodies for regulatory responsibility: the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit, the Buildings Department, the Fire Services Department and the Labour Department.

The fire on 26 November 2025 killed 168 people and displaced nearly 5,000 residents. John Lee said the government would carefully study the recommendations, announce comprehensive reforms and pursue accountability in the short term. A public version is expected after legal review so that ongoing criminal proceedings are not prejudiced.
The committee obtained more than a million documents amounting to over two trillion bytes of data during its inquiry. Officials said the contents would not be released immediately.

zh.headline: 大埔宏福苑火災獨立委員會向特首提交報告
zh.dek: 法官領導的委員會周四早上把報告交予李家超，特首表示短期內公布全面改革及追究責任，公開版本須先經法律審視。
body: 調查大埔宏福苑火災的獨立委員會周四早上向行政長官李家超提交最終報告。委員會主席陸啟康等成員約11時抵達特首辦，正式交件。
消息指報告超過十個章節，長達800至900頁、約33萬字，中英對照。報告點名四個政府部門在監管上有責任，包括房屋局獨立審查組、屋宇署、消防處及勞工處。
2025年11月26日的大火造成168人死亡，近5,000名居民受影響。李家超表示會仔細研究建議，短期內公布全面改革計劃並追究責任。因相關刑事檢控仍在進行，公開版本須先徵詢法律意見後以適當方式盡快公布。
委員會在研訊期間取得逾百萬個檔案，數據量超過二萬億字節。政府指報告暫不公開。
